values.note: 2026: water + 30-amp $46 a night spring/fall, $50 and up in summer; water + 30/50-amp $49 / $53 and up; tent sites (water and electric) $46 / $50. Base covers one camping unit, up to 5 people and 2 vehicles; extra tent $10; dump station free at departure, $10 on arrival; honey-wagon pump-out $15-18.

season.source: https://pequeacreekcampground.com/make-a-reservation/ ('OPEN for the 2026 season: April 15th until November 1st') + https://pequeacreekcampground.com/ ('The campground is open mid April – October'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservation request form on the website (staff contact you to finalize; it does not book in real time), email or phone 717-284-4587. One-night deposit; holiday weekends 3-night minimum, paid in full in advance. 7 days' notice for a refund less $10. 2027 reservations accepted after January 1.

booking.source: https://pequeacreekcampground.com/make-a-reservation/ ('a member of the Pequea Creek team to finalize your requested reservation', 'Holiday weekends require 3 night-minimum and full payment in advance') + https://pequeacreekcampground.com/ ('Please feel free to email or call if you have any questions or would like to make a reservation'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the 2026 $46-53 rates (base water+30A), 30/50-amp with water, 40-ft motorhomes, seasonal; operator also confirms creekside sites backing onto Pequea Creek. Added pull-throughs, season dates (Apr 15 - Nov 1, 2026), showers/laundry/drinking water/dump/store, reservable by request with a holiday 3-night minimum. Not stated: sewer at sites (honey-wagon service instead), site count.
